items.notes: Fixed web-only 2026-09-12, no backend needed. Yard rows with no coordinates arrive as lat/lng (0,0); 5720.8 km is Riyadh to Null Island (5720.2 computed). mapFleet now voids the sentinel, so: no pin, no distance, not called out-of-city, machine stays in the list red/unconfirmed, cell reads 'Location not specified', and the placeholder yard NAME is withheld rather than printed. Backend would still be tidier (send null, drop the 'Unspecified yard' row) but is no longer required.
